text:
Chairwoman Lisa McClain posts on Democrats' votes and American historical events
P. P. Cantu
Chairwoman Lisa McClain, U.S. Congresswoman representing Michigan’s 9th district since 2021, posted a series of statements on her Twitter account between August 3 and August 4, 2026, addressing recent political decisions, historical anniversaries, and national celebrations.
On August 3, McClain criticized Democratic lawmakers with the post: "Every single Democrat voted to take money out of YOUR pocket. Every. Single. One." This statement was made amid ongoing debates in Congress over fiscal policy and budgetary measures.
Later that day, she referenced a significant historical event by stating, "ON THIS DAY in 1492, Columbus sailed the ocean blue. His voyage led to the discovery of the land that became America—the most exceptional country on Earth. Today, the communist Left wants to wipe his name from history. Not on our watch." The message aligns with ongoing national discussions about how historical figures are remembered and commemorated in public spaces.
On August 4, McClain recognized a military anniversary with the message, "Happy 236th birthday to the United States Coast Guard! Since 1790, the brave men and women of the @USCG have protected our shores, defended our waters, and answered the call when Americans needed them most."
Lisa McClain has served as a member of Congress since replacing Paul Mitchell in Michigan’s 9th district in 2021. Born in Stockbridge, Michigan in 1966 and currently residing in Bruce at age 57, she graduated from Northwood University with a Bachelor of Business Administration degree in 1997.
